approved: Australian Broadcasting Corporation Amendment (Rural and Regional Advocacy) Bill 2015
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
The bill would change the Australian Broadcasting Corporation's charter to improve services for rural and regional Australia.
It would require the ABC Board to include two members who live in regional areas and create a Rural and Regional Advisory Council.
The bill also sets up a way to check and report on how well the ABC meets its obligations to rural and regional audiences.
Amends the ABC's charter regarding rural and regional services.
Requires two regional-residing members on the ABC Board.
Establishes a Rural and Regional Advisory Council.
Creates a reporting mechanism for rural and regional service quality.
The Australian Broadcasting Corporation and rural and regional communities in each state and territory.
